_what: The minimal record fields check:zoning-declared needs: slug + every field a selector reads.
_why: The gate ran off library/scripts/posters/out/_records.json, which is GITIGNORED (.gitignore:94), so on a clean checkout it exited 75 — NOT MEASURED forever, which is indistinguishable from an unwired gate. studio measured exactly that before wiring it into gates:post (L13U).
_fields: slug, country_code, wagf_block, wagf_region, rop1 — country_code alone is not enough: the deaf zone reads rop1 and five African/European zones read wagf_block/wagf_region.
_source: the live records API via the packet generator, same join as everything else
